title: Ugwueze Chijioke
content:
Ugwueze Chijioke  (died June 2020) was a Nigerian politician and lawmaker who represented Isi-Uzo Constituency in the Enugu State House of Assembly. He served as the chairman of the House Committee on Transport. He died in June 2020 at the age of 49.
